title: Whipped Ricotta with Honey and Pistachios
summary: A simple Italian-inspired dessert of creamy whipped ricotta topped with floral honey, crunchy pistachios and a little lemon zest. It is quick to make and ideal after a relaxed dinner.
steps: Put the ricotta, vanilla extract, a pinch of salt and 1 tablespoon of the honey into a mixing bowl.
Whip with an electric whisk for 2–3 minutes, or beat vigorously by hand for 4–5 minutes, until the ricotta looks smooth, light and creamy.
Spoon the whipped ricotta into a shallow serving bowl and swirl the surface with the back of a spoon.
Drizzle over the remaining honey, then scatter with the chopped pistachios and lemon zest.
Serve straight away, or chill for up to 1 hour before serving if you prefer it colder.
